review:
Himalayan Wild is a 5x3 mountain slot with free spins, multipliers and jackpots. Mountain-peak scatters appear on reels one, three and five, and three of them unlock nine free spins.

In the bonus, a bonus symbol landing via a line win through a wild resets the spin count to three, and a bonus symbol can award a repeat win if its value equals the amount that triggered the free spins. Free Spins and Super Free Spins can be purchased in some markets. The in-game screens advertise up to 5,000x. The RTP is 96.5%.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
